_comment: Authoritative geometry-engine parameters for every model in the bundle. `engine` is passed straight to build() in js/geometry.js. Per-model plan data (printed schedules, materials, notes) lives in data/models/<key>.json and is optional — the 3D model renders from `engine` alone.

models.label: Do-Deca-Dome
models.blurb: 35 identical panels — the simplest build in the bundle.

models.label: Beginner Bucky Ball
models.blurb: Truncated icosahedron — every edge the same length, one bevel angle.

models.label: 3V Dome on pony wall
models.blurb: 5/8 sphere raised on a short stud wall for headroom.

models.label: 3V Bucky Ball Dome
models.blurb: Two panel shapes, two miter settings. The classic starter dome.

models.label: 3V Dome on pony wall
models.blurb: 5/8 sphere on a taller pony wall — usable floor right to the edge.

models.label: 3V Bucky Ball Dome
models.blurb: The flagship 3V. 73 hex panels, 30 pent panels, 4 opening windows.

models.label: Barn Dome
models.blurb: 3/8 sphere on a tall wall with an 8′ door bay — workshop proportions.

models.label: 4V Dome
models.blurb: Half sphere, 4V breakdown — four panel shapes.

models.label: 4V Dome
models.blurb: Half sphere at 30 feet — the largest single-storey plan.

models.label: 4V Dome — Config One
models.blurb: Deep Frame Method: full 2×6 on edge, low profile plus a 3′6″ wall.

models.label: 4V Dome — Config Two
models.blurb: Deep Frame Method: 5/8 sphere on a short wall — two full storeys.

models.label: Acorn Zome (sauna)
models.blurb: Six bands, carried past the equator — the acorn silhouette.

models.label: Zome
models.blurb: Every frame strut one length. Five bands of rhombus panels.

models.label: Zome
models.blurb: The mid-size zome. One strut length, five miter settings.

models.label: Zome
models.blurb: Non-beveled build — square-edged frame, simpler shop work.

models.label: Zome
models.blurb: The largest zome in the bundle — nearly 20 feet tall.
